look_here_first: Check for a thick woody root crown and persistent previous-year basal stems, then inspect phyllaries and rays.

morphology_keys.root: Woody perennial taproot and persistent basal stems
morphology_keys.head: About 24-65, occasionally 170, rays 4-7 mm (sometimes 11 mm); involucre 3-4.5 mm
morphology_keys.habit: Early growth may have one large head; late growth often many smaller heads

comparisons.key_distinctions: E. geiseri has a slender annual root and characteristic lower versus upper stem hairs; rays and flowering time overlap.
comparisons.cautions: Variable polyploid complex; voucher sometimes needed. E. plateauensis and E. lobatus var. warnockii are synonyms.
